item.text: The central resolver already exists in `payments/core/subscription/helpers.ts`; the inconsistency is that the assistant hook duplicates its full mapping. The core public entry point currently exports neither it nor `SelectedPlan`, so I’ll expose both there and have the single and organization flows build their `planIDs` from the selected base plan plus an optional resolver result.

The inline plan mapping is removed, and the helpers now omit an addon cleanly when the centralized resolver has no match. I also found another direct `SelectedPlan` internal-path import in the plan customizer and moved it to the public entry point to satisfy the import requirement consistently. I’m checking the changed files and running the existing assistant upsell test now.
The test command has started but has produced no output yet; I’m giving it a little more time to finish before deciding whether it’s stalled.

item.text:
Implemented the assistant upsell resolver update. Paid configs now build `planIDs` with an optional addon, and addon names come from `getScribeAddonNameByPlan`. Exported that resolver and `SelectedPlan` from the payments/core entry point and updated imports.

The existing assistant upsell test passed: 9 tests. `git diff --check` passed, and no legacy resolver references or internal `SelectedPlan` imports remain.
